headline: Alberta’s Separation Question Is a Non-Binding Vote
deck: Question 10 asks whether Alberta should remain in Canada or begin the legal process for a binding referendum; its result will not bind the province.
body: Alberta’s referendum has ten questions, Elections Alberta says. [E1]
Question 10 asks whether Alberta should remain a province of Canada or whether its government should begin the constitutional legal process for a binding provincial referendum on separation. [E2]
Elections Alberta says the order establishing Question 10 also orders that its result is not binding. [E3]
The BBC reported that Albertans will vote on 19 October on whether to remain in Canada or trigger a binding independence referendum. [E4]
